patterns.note: A prominent, full-width hero image is followed by a two-column newsletter section, then subsequent content is presented in consistent three-column article grids.
Section and article headings utilize a large, elegant serif font, creating a strong editorial presence, while navigation and meta-information use a smaller, clean sans-serif.
The primary color scheme is a high-contrast black text on a white background, with dark grey used for the footer and very subtle light grey horizontal dividers.

A multi-tiered sticky header system where the main logo/utility navigation, a primary category navigation, and a 'TRENDING' sub-navigation bar all become fixed at the top of the viewport sequentially as the user scrolls down.
Each content category is introduced by a large, centered serif heading, followed by a grid of image-dominant article cards, and concluded with a 'VIEW MORE' call-to-action button.

technique_notes: Implement a multi-level sticky header where the top-most utility bar, the main category navigation, and a 'TRENDING' sub-navigation bar sequentially fix to the top of the viewport as the user scrolls past their initial positions.

Structure content using a flexible grid system that adapts from a two-column layout for a newsletter section to a consistent three-column layout for article listings, emphasizing large, high-quality images as primary visual elements within each grid item.

Establish a clear visual hierarchy using a large, elegant serif font for all major headings and article titles to convey a premium editorial feel, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for smaller text elements like navigation, bylines, and dates.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, functional sans-serif body and meta text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, leaning towards airy in the hero and section breaks, but dense within article grids

standout: The site's distinctive use of a classic, high-contrast editorial layout, combining elegant serif typography for headlines with a clean, image-heavy grid structure, gives it the feel of a digital luxury magazine rather than a typical blog or news site. The multi-level sticky navigation is also a notable feature.
